name: Progressive Blur Gallery
description: Scrolling editorial image gallery rendered in WebGL, where images start blurred with film grain and sharpen as they scroll, with a hero title, captions and a staggered blur-in text list.
contents: Hero eyebrow and title above a large hero image
Several image layout rows with numbered captions
Three-column text list that blurs in on scroll
Fixed full-screen WebGL canvas drawing the images
behavior: Images are drawn as OGL planes with a blur and noise shader synced to page scroll
Hero image sharpens and scales slightly as the page scrolls
List items fade from blur to sharp when they enter the viewport
editableByProps: Images, hero text and list labels
Blur, grain, hero scale and list animation amounts
Smooth scroll on or off and its duration

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the image layout rows or their proportions
needsCodeEdit.where: The section elements after the hero section in the returned JSX

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the blur or grain look

fixed: Draws images on a fixed full-screen canvas behind the content
Takes over page scrolling with Lenis when lenisEnabled is true, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Needs at least 9 images, the layout uses images by index
Layout images are hidden DOM images that the canvas redraws, so image hosts must allow cross-origin loading
